title: Marriage
author: Susan Ferrier
description: "Marriage" by Susan Ferrier is a novel written during the early 19th century.
longDescription: The story centers around Lady Juliana, the daughter of the Earl of Courtland, who is caught between her father's ambitions for her and her affection for a handsome but penniless suitor.

authorInfo.bio: Susan Ferrier (1782–1854) wrote Marriage. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
